//UnitContent: Creator-editable Unit definitions. Edit this file and restart the API; no C# change,
no React change and no EF migration is involved.
'Key' is the stable identity. Player-owned Unit rows store it and nothing else about the
definition, so every other field below is free to change at any time. Do not rename a key
TEMPORARY PROTOTYPE VALUES, NOT CANON: 'Tier' 1 and 'MaxArmor' Heavy on all three entries
are placeholders because the creator has explicitly deferred authoring those details.
'Heavy' is deliberately permissive. 'Mounted' is the one field here with structural
meaning, and 'Melee'/'Ranged'/'Mounted' are identity labels only: canon allows any Unit to
equip any compatible weapon, and nothing in the application reads a display name.
